accessibility_desc: Screen reader announcements and assistive technology options.
screen_reader_desc: Announce important events (imports, errors, git actions) through your screen reader as they happen.
screen_reader_beta_desc: This is an untested feature. If you require a screen reader, please help test it and report any bugs so they can be fixed as soon as possible.
git_auth_instructions: Authorize GodotHub in your browser. A verification page should have opened. If not, use the button below.
git_oauth_hint: Sign in to authenticate HTTPS push, pull, fetch, and clone.
git_self_hosted_desc: Connect to your own GitLab instance. Create an OAuth application on your instance (scopes: read_repository, write_repository, read_user) and paste its base URL and Application ID.
git_pat_desc: Add a personal access token for hosts that don't support OAuth device sign-in (e.g. Codeberg, Gitea, Bitbucket). GodotHub uses it to authenticate HTTPS remotes on that host.
storage_desc: Folders GodotHub checks at startup. Star a folder to also use it as the default location for new projects/downloads.
behavior_desc: How GodotHub acts when you launch a project.
behavior_projects_desc: How projects are organized in GodotHub.
file_watchers_desc: Automatically detect changes in your scan folders and keep projects, versions, and templates up to date without clicking Sync.
last_opened_desc: Controls the "last opened" pill shown on project cards. Hidden entirely for projects that have never been opened.
github_token_desc: Optionally set a GitHub personal access token to increase the API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests per hour when fetching available Godot versions. No scopes/permissions needed.
titlebar_buttons_desc: Show or hide the buttons in the titlebar.
restart_app_desc: Fully restart GodotHub. Useful after changing window decorations or when the app feels stuck.
restart_app_confirm_desc: The app will close and reopen automatically. Unsaved in-progress operations may be interrupted.
reset_settings_desc: Restores all settings back to default. This does not remove your projects, categories, templates, or Godot versions.
delete_data_desc: Permanently wipes every workspace, project, category, installed-version record, and setting GodotHub has stored. You will be restarted at first-time setup. Your actual project folders and Godot installs on disk are not touched, unless they live in the default download folder.
theme_follow_desc: Follow the OS light/dark preference automatically. The theme updates live when you switch the system appearance.
reset_all_desc: This restores every setting on this page, download folder, scan folders, appearance, and behavior, back to their defaults. This can't be undone.
delete_all_desc: This permanently deletes every workspace, project, category, installed-version record, and setting GodotHub has stored, and restarts you at first-time setup. Your actual project folders and Godot installs on disk are not touched, unless they live in the default download folder, in which case they're deleted too. This can't be undone.
empty_hint_projects: No folders added, nothing will be scanned at startup, and new projects will ask where to save each time.
empty_hint_versions: No folders added, nothing will be scanned at startup, and new downloads will use the app data folder.
git_init_new_projects_desc: Tick the Git option by default in the New Project dialog. It adds a Godot .gitignore, a .gitattributes, and an initial commit on main.
naming_convention_desc: How the project folder is named when you create a new project. The project name always keeps the spaces you typed; only the folder name is transformed.
theme_preset_desc: Pick a full color theme. A preset controls every color in the app; choose Custom to use your own accent and background.
scan_result: Found {{projects}} new project(s) and {{versions}} new version(s).
keybind_instruction: Click the button below, then press any key to rebind.
template_scan_desc: Any subfolders inside this directory will be imported as templates when you click 'Import from Directory' in the Templates view.
launch_console_desc: Launches Godot in your terminal emulator so engine output is visible.
launch_console_desc_windows: Shows engine output, print() calls and errors in a console window, using the console executable Godot ships alongside the editor. Only available for versions that include one.
close_on_open_desc: Quits GodotHub automatically as soon as a project is launched in Godot.
close_on_open_desc_mac: Hides GodotHub automatically as soon as a project is launched in Godot. It keeps running in the Dock.
minimize_tray_label: Minimize to system tray on closing app
minimize_tray_desc: Keeps GodotHub running in the system tray instead of quitting when you close the window. Use the tray icon to reopen or quit.
reopen_desc: Brings GodotHub back out of the system tray automatically once the Godot editor for that project is closed.
reopen_desc_mac: Brings GodotHub back automatically once the Godot editor for that project is closed.
no_folder_set: No folder set. You can still import manually or use 'Save as Template'.
workspaces_off_desc: Turns off workspaces entirely, no workspace switcher, no "add workspace" button. GodotHub behaves as if there were only the one currently-active workspace. Existing workspaces are kept and the switcher comes back if you turn this on again.
date_format_label: Date format (shown for any other day)
projects_desc: Scanned at startup for existing projects. The starred folder pre-fills the "Location" field in the New Project dialog.
godot_versions_desc: Scanned at startup for installed Godot executables. The starred folder is where new Godot versions are extracted when you install them.
scan_depth_desc: How many folders deep to look inside each scan folder above. Lower is faster and avoids picking up unrelated projects/versions buried in nested subfolders; higher digs further if yours are deeply nested.
icon_scan_depth_desc: How many folders deep to search inside a project for its icon when the icon is referenced by UID (e.g. uid://...). Lower is faster; higher finds icons buried in deeply nested folders like assets/ui/icons.
download_concurrency_desc: How many Godot versions can download at the same time. Extra downloads wait in a queue and start automatically as slots free up.
tray_recent_desc: How many recently opened projects appear in the system tray context menu. Set between 1 and 10.
auto_scan_desc: Automatically scans your configured project and version folders for new additions every time GodotHub starts. You can still scan manually anytime from the Projects and Versions views.
tooltip_delay_desc: How long to wait before showing tooltips when hovering over buttons, icons, and sidebar items. Lower values feel more responsive; higher values reduce distraction.
watch_projects_desc: Automatically scans for new or removed projects whenever files change inside your configured project scan folders. New project folders are added to your library; removed ones are left in place but unregistered.
watch_versions_desc: Automatically scans for new or removed Godot executables whenever files change inside your configured version scan folders. New executables are added to your installed versions list.
watch_template_desc: Automatically syncs templates whenever files change inside your template scan directory. Edit a template folder and the template content updates automatically.
watcher_footer_desc: Watchers use debounced file system events. Changes are detected within a few seconds of the last file save. Disabling a watcher frees system resources.
corner_radius_desc: Controls every rounded corner in the app, cards, buttons, inputs, and dropdowns. 0 for sharp, square corners.
density_desc: Scales padding, margins, and spacing everywhere, lower for a tighter, compact layout.
text_size_desc: Scales all text (and anything sized relative to it) across the app.
scrollbar_desc: Hides the scrollbar across the entire app when toggled off. You can still scroll with keyboard, trackpad, or mouse wheel.
animated_numbers_desc: Animate the counters in the new interface headers (projects, templates, versions, news, asset store). Turn off for plain static numbers.
animation_intensity_desc: Controls how much motion the app plays. Full keeps all animations, Subtle shortens them, and None disables them entirely.
view_entrance_desc: The animation used when switching views and tabs.
custom_css_desc: Inject your own CSS to restyle anything in the app. Applies instantly on save. Use it for fine-grained tweaks the built-in settings can't express.
animation_threshold_desc: Project lists larger than this render without entrance/exit animations, keeping the view fast on weaker machines. Lower values animate fewer cards.
time_tracking_desc: Export your projects' open-time stats to a file you can keep anywhere. Restore it on a new computer or after a full app-data reset.
clear_stats_confirm_desc: This permanently deletes all time tracking history, session records, and per-project totals. This cannot be undone.
settings_backup_desc: Export all settings plus your time tracking data to a JSON file, or restore them from a previous backup. Workspace-specific data and setup state are kept as-is on this machine.
workspace_backup_desc: Export your entire workspace (projects, categories, templates, settings and time tracking) to a single JSON file, or restore it from a backup. Restoring replaces the current workspace's data.
app_backup_desc: Export ALL of your workspaces (settings, projects, categories, templates and time tracking for every workspace) to a single JSON file, or restore it. Restoring matches workspaces by name, workspaces that already exist get overwritten, new ones are created.
sync_desc: Push Your App Data to Github Gist and Restore it from any machine. This includes all workspaces, projects, categories, templates, settings, and time tracking data.
sync_push_done: All workspaces pushed to your gist.
sync_manual_hint: Lost your local data? Enter your gist URL or ID to restore from any machine.
restore_modal_desc: Review what will be restored from your GitHub gist backup.
restore_modal_project_scan_dirs: {{count}} project scan folder(s) will be restored
restore_modal_version_scan_dirs: {{count}} Godot version folder(s) will be restored
restore_modal_warning: This will overwrite your current settings and workspace data. You'll need to restart the app to apply changes.
restore_modal_done_desc: Your workspace data has been restored.
restore_modal_done_hint: Click the button below to restart and apply all changes.
icon_opacity_desc: Controls the background icon opacity on project cards. Lower values make the icon more subtle, higher values make it more visible.
background_color_desc: Background color applies across all themes. In light mode the app derives card surfaces, borders, and overlays from your chosen background. In dark mode the background sets the base page color.
raised_contrast_desc: How far raised surfaces (cards, inputs, menus) sit from your background color. Higher values give more separation; 0 makes them identical to the background.
setup_wizard_desc: Reopens the first-time setup flow where you can reconfigure scan folders, categories, accent color, and corner radius. Settings already saved will be kept, you can always skip steps you don't need to change.
report_bug_desc: Help improve GodotHub by reporting issues on GitHub.
token_help_desc: Create a token at github.com/settings/tokens. You only need to check the repo scope if you want private repo access, otherwise leave all scopes unchecked. No sensitive permissions required.
discord_rpc_desc: Shows what you're doing in GodotHub on your Discord profile; the project you're running with an elapsed timer, or that you're browsing GodotHub. Requires the Discord desktop app to be running.
discord_app_id_placeholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default
discord_app_id_desc: Create an application in the Discord Developer Portal and paste its Application ID here to use your own instead of GodotHub's built-in one. The activity shows under that application's name.
discord_show_projects_desc: Show the name of the project you're running (and its Godot version) in your Discord presence, with an elapsed timer. Turn this off to keep your projects private.
discord_excluded_desc: Projects in this list never appear by name in your presence, even while running. The elapsed timer still shows.
discord_custom_desc: Set custom Details and State text that shows on your Discord profile when a specific project is running. Leave a field empty to fall back to the project name and version.
card_layout_desc: Show the sidebar, views, and titlebar as separate floating rounded cards. Turn off for a connected layout where everything merges into one surface, like the classic UI.
landing_tab_desc: Which view opens when the app starts. The dashboard is only available in the new UI, so the classic interface falls back to Projects.
use_os_decorations_desc: Use your operating system's native title bar and window controls instead of GodotHub's custom title bar. Requires a restart to take full effect.
credits_desc: GodotHub is open source and built by the community.
experimental_desc: Try out new features that are still in development. These may be unstable or change without notice.
customize_view_desc: Show the Customize View button in the Projects view. When disabled, added views are removed and the view resets to List only.
git_worktrees_desc: Show the Worktrees section in the Git sidebar. Worktrees let you check out multiple branches simultaneously in separate directories.
fixed_sidebar_resize_knob_desc: Keeps the sidebar resize handle pinned at the center of the edge instead of following the cursor. Resizing still works by dragging the edge.
desktop_notifications_desc: Show an OS notification when long operations finish (installs, clones, Git sync), even when the window is in the background.
colored_titlebar_buttons_desc: Use colored macOS-style circles for the minimize, maximize and close buttons. When disabled, the titlebar uses standard Windows-style buttons.
